text: I think she is the prettiest person in the world.” “I am sure she is,” said Miss Vivian Herbert. And she laughed and kissed his cheek again. She kept him by her side a great part of the evening, and the group of which they were the center was very gay. He did not know how it happened, but before long he was telling them all about America, and the Republican Rally, and Mr. Hobbs and Dick, and in the end he proudly produced from his pocket Dick's parting gift,--the red silk handkerchief. “I put it in my pocket to-night because it was a party,” he said.
